tooltip.hbr_mc.knife_cut_noodles.line1: The ones who stand in front of a boiling pot of water, a knife in hand,
tooltip.hbr_mc.knife_cut_noodles.line2: dough in the other, and slice nice-and-thin pieces into the pot until they're boiled!
hbr_mc.msg.teleport_command: Hint: enable Seraph teleportation first with /seraphtp, then right-click to teleport.
hbr_mc.msg.teleport_command_rough: Hint: that block face is incomplete (slab/carpet...); a rough mode is required to teleport there.
